reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed with the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already implements the missing/single/range (furthest from zero) rule.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the field is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal, the API model mapping used by the schedule list, with the list type declared next to APIScheduleEntity and the handler type updated.

scope.why: Touches only the API model, the handler type, the docs entry and the API test expectation.

maintainability.why: A separate read-only list type keeps the input type unchanged, and any future change to the amount rule flows through the shared helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getScheduledAmount and the existing scheduleModel mapping.
